subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the sentence.

He laboured very hard but could not yield anything from the __barren__ piece of land.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"barren"** means unable to produce or sustain life; not productive or fruitful. (बंजर)

 
 
• **Example: **The farmers struggled to grow crops on the barren land.
 
 
 
• **"Fertile" **refers to land or soil that is rich in nutrients and capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops. (उपजाऊ)
 
 
• **Example: **The fertile plains of the region are ideal for growing wheat and corn.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'barren'** is **'fertile'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fruitless **(अफल): Producing no useful or desired result.

 
 
• **Example:** His efforts to negotiate a truce were fruitless.
 
 
 
• **Vile **(नीच): Extremely unpleasant or morally bad.
 
 
• **Example: **He was arrested for his vile behavior towards his neighbors.
 
 
 
• **Sterile** (बाँझ): Unable to produce offspring or fruit; free from bacteria or other living microorganisms.
 
 
• **Example:** The sterile environment of the laboratory ensures that experiments are not contaminated.
